original.target_description: Study 1: two-year-old infants; looking duration at correct versus incorrect windows during first 1750 ms; repeated-measures ANOVA with window location within subjects and FB1/FB2 condition between subjects. Requested partial eta squared identifies duration ANOVA rather than first-saccade binomial test.

n.sample_role: infants included in the window-looking-duration analysis (10 FB1, 10 FB2)
n.exclusions: 16 additional children excluded: inclusion criterion (11), looking away at crucial test moment (2), looking at neither door (2), calibration failure (1).
n.location: Accepted manuscript p. 4, Participants; p. 7, Results
n.quote:

es.location: Accepted manuscript p. 7, Results, second paragraph

replication.target_description: Study 1, Southgate et al. (2007)/Senju et al. (2009) paradigm: adult participants, overall differential looking score (DLS) pooled across false-belief conditions, one-sample t test against zero. This is the duration-based replication analysis on locator p. 6, rather than the separate FB1/FB2 tests.

n.sample_role: adult participants with overall DLS in the Southgate/Senju paradigm (Table 1 diagonal N); target one-sample test reports t(50)
n.exclusions: 119 adults tested overall; main text says 54 passed this paradigm’s original inclusion criteria, but Table 1 gives N = 51 for its DLS and the target test reports t(50). Reasons for the further missing DLS observations are not specified in the examined main paper; paradigm-specific exclusion details are referred to Supplement A.
n.location: PDF p. 7, Table 1, row 3 / column 3 diagonal (DLS Southgate et al. and Senju et al.); p. 6, corresponding test; p. 4, sample/inclusion description

notes: Original title verified in frozen cached accepted manuscript; supplied p. 4 is its Participants section and the requested partial eta squared identifies the looking-duration ANOVA on manuscript p. 7. Replication title and DOI verified in university-hosted full paper. Replication uses adults, not the original infant population; it reports overall DLS rather than the original duration ANOVA. Overall narrative verdict is failed, with an explicitly qualified successful FB1 subset. Replication n = 54 in the results paragraph is the paradigm inclusion count; retained analytic DLS N = 51 is explicitly printed in Table 1 and consistent with t(50). No metric conversion or sample-size derivation performed.
